shortDescription: Create and delete a DigitalOcean droplet

options.name: backups
options.description: Indicates whether automated backups should be enabled.

options.name: baseurl
options.description: DigitalOcean API base url.

options.name: firewall
options.description: Array of firewall names to apply to the Droplet. Omitting a firewall name that is currently applied to a droplet will remove it.

options.name: id
options.description: The Droplet ID you want to operate on.

options.name: image
options.description: This is the slug of the image you would like the Droplet created with.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Enable IPv6 for the Droplet.

options.name: monitoring
options.description: Indicates whether to install the DigitalOcean agent for monitoring.

options.name: name
options.description: This is the name of the Droplet. Must be formatted by hostname rules.

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. There are several other environment variables which can be used to provide this value. i.e., - C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN).

options.name: private_networking
options.description: Add an additional, private network interface to the Droplet (for inter-Droplet communication).

options.name: project_name
options.description: Project to assign the resource to (project name, not UUID). Defaults to the default project of the account (empty string). Currently only supported when creating.

options.name: region
options.description: This is the slug of the region you would like your Droplet to be created in.

options.name: resize_disk
options.description: Whether to increase disk size on resize. Only consulted if the C(unique_name) is C(true). Droplet C(size) must dictate an increase.

options.name: size
options.description: This is the slug of the size you would like the Droplet created with. Please see U(https://slugs.do-api.dev/) for current slugs.

options.name: sleep_interval
options.description: How long to C(sleep) in between action and status checks. Default is 10 seconds; this should be less than C(wait_timeout) and nonzero.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: Array of SSH key fingerprints that you would like to be added to the Droplet.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target. C(present) will create the named droplet; be mindful of the C(unique_name) parameter. C(absent) will delete the named droplet, if it exists. C(active) will create the named droplet (unless it exists) and ensure that it is powered on. C(inactive) will create the named droplet (unless it exists) and ensure that it is powered off.

options.name: tags
options.description: A list of tag names as strings to apply to the Droplet after it is created. Tag names can either be existing or new tags.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds used for polling DigitalOcean's API.

options.name: unique_name
options.description: Require unique hostnames. By default, DigitalOcean allows multiple hosts with the same name. Setting this to C(true) allows only one host per name. Useful for idempotence.

options.name: user_data
options.description: Opaque blob of data which is made available to the Droplet.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: volumes
options.description: A list including the unique string identifier for each Block Storage volume to be attached to the Droplet.

options.name: vpc_uuid
options.description: A string specifying the UUID of the VPC to which the Droplet will be assigned. If excluded, the Droplet will be assigned to the account's default VPC for the region.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the Droplet to be active before returning. If wait is C(false) an IP address may not be returned.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before C(wait) gives up, in seconds, when creating a Droplet.
